description: This Java class implements data access object (DAO) for WidgetsBundle entities, providing methods for querying and managing widget bundle data in a SQL database within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: JpaWidgetsBundleDao
classes.description: DAO implementation for WidgetsBundle entities, providing database operations such as find, search, and retrieval based on various criteria.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO, which is WidgetsBundleEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides access to the JpaRepository for WidgetsBundleEntity.

methods.name: findWidgetsBundleByTenantIdAndAlias
methods.description: Finds a WidgetsBundle by tenant ID and alias.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Retrieves system widget bundles with optional full search filtering.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds widget bundles for a specific tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all widget bundles for a tenant, including system bundles.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Overloaded method to find tenant widget bundles based on filter criteria.

methods.name: findAllWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Retrieves all widget bundles with pagination.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantWidgetBundlesByIds
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by a list of IDs, including system and tenant bundles.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantIds
methods.description: Helper method to find widget bundles for multiple tenants with optional full search.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a widget bundle by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a widget bundle by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds widget bundles for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a widget bundle given its internal ID.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageLink
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by tenant ID and image URL with limit.

methods.name: findByImageLink
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by image URL with limit.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Alias for findByTenantId, retrieves widget bundles for a tenant.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of entity fields starting from a given ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is WIDGETS_BUNDLE.
